The restaurant is attractive with several dining areas.

I was not impressed with the toilet facilities.

The papaya salad was not very special, it should be more spicy, more sourness and sweetness and less papaya. Red curry with sticky rice was really nice for a rainy day. Our favourite was barbecue chicken wrapped in pandan leaves, so sweet, so tender.
